title: 必须 — to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily
title_en: 必须 — to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily
summary: A short passage about to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily.
summary_en: A short passage about to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily.

paragraphs.text: 無論結果如何，比賽的過程必須公平。
paragraphs.hanzi: 無論結果如何，比賽的過程必須公平。
paragraphs.pinyin: wú lùn jié guǒ rú hé ， bǐ sài de guò chéng bì xū gōng píng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨˊ ㄌㄨㄣˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄖㄨˊ ㄏㄜˊ ， ㄅㄧˇ ㄙㄞˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄆㄧㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Wúlùn jiéguǒ rúhé, bǐsài de guòchéng bìxū gōngpíng.
paragraphs.translation: No matter what the result is, the process of the competition must be fair.
paragraphs.translation_en: No matter what the result is, the process of the competition must be fair.
paragraphs.translation_id: Apapun hasilnya, proses persaingan harus adil.

paragraphs.text: 時間很緊，我們必須先處理最重要的部分。
paragraphs.hanzi: 時間很緊，我們必須先處理最重要的部分。
paragraphs.pinyin: shí jiān hěn jǐn ， wǒ men bì xū xiān chù lǐ zuì zhòng yào de bù fèn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄏㄣˇ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄔㄨˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄈㄣˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shíjiān hěn jǐn, wǒmen bìxū xiān chǔlǐ zuì zhòngyào de bùfen.
paragraphs.translation: Time is tight, so we must deal with the most important part first.
paragraphs.translation_en: Time is tight, so we must deal with the most important part first.
paragraphs.translation_id: Waktu sangat terbatas, jadi kita harus menangani bagian yang paling penting terlebih dahulu.

paragraphs.text: 這個路口行人很多，司機必須減速。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這個路口行人很多，司機必須減速。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè gè lù kǒu xíng rén hěn duō ， sī jī bì xū jiǎn sù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ， ㄙ ㄐㄧ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄐㄧㄢˇ ㄙㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhège lùkǒu xíngrén hěn duō, sījī bìxū jiǎnsù.
paragraphs.translation: There are many pedestrians at this junction, so drivers must slow down.
paragraphs.translation_en: There are many pedestrians at this junction, so drivers must slow down.
paragraphs.translation_id: Banyak pejalan kaki di persimpangan ini, sehingga pengemudi harus memperlambat kecepatan.

paragraphs.text: 處理緊急事務時，必須先分清事情的輕重。
paragraphs.hanzi: 處理緊急事務時，必須先分清事情的輕重。
paragraphs.pinyin: chù lǐ jǐn jí shì wù shí ， bì xū xiān fēn qīng shì qíng de qīng zhòng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄨˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄐㄧˊ ㄕˋ ㄨˋ ㄕˊ ， ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄈㄣ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄕˋ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄓㄨㄥˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Chǔlǐ jǐnjí shìwù shí, bìxū xiān fēn qīng shìqing de qīngzhòng.
paragraphs.translation: When handling urgent matters, one must first distinguish their relative importance.
paragraphs.translation_en: When handling urgent matters, one must first distinguish their relative importance.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saat menangani hal-hal yang mendesak, seseorang harus terlebih dahulu membedakan tingkat kepentingannya masing-masing.

paragraphs.text: 在籤合同之前，我們必須先計算總成本和可能的風險。
paragraphs.hanzi: 在籤合同之前，我們必須先計算總成本和可能的風險。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài qiān hé tóng zhī qián ， wǒ men bì xū xiān jì suàn zǒng chéng běn hé kě néng de fēng xiǎn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄑㄧㄢ ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄓ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄐㄧˋ ㄙㄨㄢˋ ㄗㄨㄥˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄈㄥ ㄒㄧㄢˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zài qiān hétong zhīqián, wǒmen bìxū xiān jìsuàn zǒng chéngběn hé kěnéng de fēngxiǎn.
paragraphs.translation: Before signing the contract, we must first calculate the total cost and possible risks.
paragraphs.translation_en: Before signing the contract, we must first calculate the total cost and possible risks.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sebelum menandatangani kontrak, kita harus menghitung dulu total biaya dan risiko yang mungkin terjadi.

paragraphs.text: 網上辦事越來越便捷，但個人信息保護必須同步加強。
paragraphs.hanzi: 網上辦事越來越便捷，但個人信息保護必須同步加強。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǎng shàng bàn shì yuè lái yuè biàn jié ， dàn gè rén xìn xī bǎo hù bì xū tóng bù jiā qiáng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄤˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄅㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄩㄝˋ ㄌㄞˊ ㄩㄝˋ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ， ㄉㄢˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄒㄧㄣˋ ㄒㄧ ㄅㄠˇ ㄏㄨˋ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄑㄧㄤˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Wǎngshàng bànshì yuè lái yuè biànjié, dàn gèrén zīxùn bǎohù bìxū tóngbù jiāqiáng.
paragraphs.translation: Handling administrative tasks online is becoming more convenient, but the protection of personal information must be strengthened at the same time.
paragraphs.translation_en: Handling administrative tasks online is becoming more convenient, but the protection of personal information must be strengthened at the same time.
paragraphs.translation_id: Menangani tugas-tugas administratif secara online menjadi lebih mudah, namun perlindungan informasi pribadi harus diperkuat pada saat yang bersamaan.

title: 安全 — safe / safety
summary: A short passage about safe / safety.
summary_en: A short passage about safe / safety.

paragraphs.text: 上車以後，請先繫好安全帶，再讓司機出發。
paragraphs.hanzi: 上車以後，請先繫好安全帶，再讓司機出發。
paragraphs.pinyin: shàng chē yǐ hòu ， qǐng xiān xì hǎo ān quán dài ， zài ràng sī jī chū fā 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕㄤˋ ㄔㄜ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄒㄧˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄉㄞˋ ， ㄗㄞˋ ㄖㄤˋ ㄙ ㄐㄧ ㄔㄨ ㄈㄚ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shàng chē yǐhòu, qǐng xiān jì hǎo ānquándài, zài ràng sījī chūfā.
paragraphs.translation: After getting in the car, please fasten your seatbelt before letting the driver set off.
paragraphs.translation_en: After getting in the car, please fasten your seatbelt before letting the driver set off.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah masuk ke dalam mobil, harap kencangkan sabuk pengaman Anda sebelum membiarkan pengemudi berangkat.

paragraphs.text: 這次事故提高了大家的安全意識。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這次事故提高了大家的安全意識。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè cì shì gù tí gāo le dà jiā de ān quán yì shí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄘˋ ㄕˋ ㄍㄨˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄠ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄉㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄧˋ ㄕˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè cì shìgù tígāo le dàjiā de ānquán yìshí.
paragraphs.translation: This accident raised everyone’s safety awareness.
paragraphs.translation_en: This accident raised everyone’s safety awareness.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kecelakaan ini meningkatkan kesadaran keselamatan semua orang.

paragraphs.text: 下雨天穿拖鞋出門不太安全。
paragraphs.hanzi: 下雨天穿拖鞋出門不太安全。
paragraphs.pinyin: xià yǔ tiān chuān tuō xié chū mén bù tài ān quán 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄩˇ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄔㄨㄢ ㄊㄨㄛ ㄒㄧㄝˊ ㄔㄨ ㄇㄣˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Xiàyǔ tiān chuān tuōxié chūmén bú tài ānquán.
paragraphs.translation: It is not very safe to go out in slippers on a rainy day.
paragraphs.translation_en: It is not very safe to go out in slippers on a rainy day.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sangat tidak aman untuk keluar rumah dengan memakai sandal saat hujan.

paragraphs.text: 他們在池邊安裝了新的安全標誌。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他們在池邊安裝了新的安全標誌。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā men zài chí biān ān zhuāng le xīn de ān quán biāo zhì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄗㄞˋ ㄔˊ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄢ ㄓㄨㄤ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄅㄧㄠ ㄓˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tāmen zài chí biān ānzhuāng le xīn de ānquán biāozhì.
paragraphs.translation: They installed a new safety sign beside the pond.
paragraphs.translation_en: They installed a new safety sign beside the pond.
paragraphs.translation_id: Mereka memasang tanda keselamatan baru di samping kolam.

paragraphs.text: 請把安全帶繫好，車輛馬上就要出發。
paragraphs.hanzi: 請把安全帶繫好，車輛馬上就要出發。
paragraphs.pinyin: qǐng bǎ ān quán dài xì hǎo ， chē liàng mǎ shàng jiù yào chū fā 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄒㄧˋ ㄏㄠˇ ， ㄔㄜ ㄌㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄚˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔㄨ ㄈㄚ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Qǐng bǎ ānquándài jì hǎo, chēliàng mǎshàng jiù yào chūfā.
paragraphs.translation: Please fasten your seat belt; the vehicle is about to set off.
paragraphs.translation_en: Please fasten your seat belt; the vehicle is about to set off.
paragraphs.translation_id: Harap kencangkan sabuk pengaman Anda; kendaraan akan berangkat.

paragraphs.text: 每個人都要提高自身的安全意識。
paragraphs.hanzi: 每個人都要提高自身的安全意識。
paragraphs.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu yào tí gāo zì shēn de ān quán yì shí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄇㄟˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄉㄡ ㄧㄠˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄠ ㄗˋ ㄕㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄧˋ ㄕˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Měi ge rén dōu yào tígāo zìshēn de ānquán yìshí.
paragraphs.translation: Everyone should raise their own awareness of safety.
paragraphs.translation_en: Everyone should raise their own awareness of safety.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setiap orang harus meningkatkan kesadaran mereka akan keselamatan.

title: 报告 — to make a report / report
title_en: 报告 — to make a report / report
summary: A short passage about to make a report / report.
summary_en: A short passage about to make a report / report.
summary_id: Bacaan singkat tentang untuk membuat laporan.

paragraphs.text: 李小姐提交的報告寫得非常清楚。
paragraphs.hanzi: 李小姐提交的報告寫得非常清楚。
paragraphs.pinyin: lǐ xiǎo jiě tí jiāo de bào gào xiě dé fēi cháng qīng chǔ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄌㄧˇ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄝˇ ㄉㄜˊ ㄈㄟ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄔㄨˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Lǐ xiǎojiě tíjiāo de bàogào xiě de fēicháng qīngchu.
paragraphs.translation: Miss Li’s submitted report was written very clearly.
paragraphs.translation_en: Miss Li’s submitted report was written very clearly.
paragraphs.translation_id: Laporan yang disampaikan Nona Li ditulis dengan sangat jelas.

paragraphs.text: 他第一次嘗試用中文做報告，緊張得說錯了幾個詞。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他第一次嘗試用中文做報告，緊張得說錯了幾個詞。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā dì yī cì cháng shì yòng zhōng wén zuò bào gào ， jǐn zhāng dé shuō cuò le jǐ gè cí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ ㄘˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄕˋ ㄩㄥˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄨㄣˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ， ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄓㄤ ㄉㄜˊ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄐㄧˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄘˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā dì yī cì chángshì yòng Zhōngwén zuò bàogào, jǐnzhāng de shuō cuò le jǐ ge cí.
paragraphs.translation: He tried giving a report in Chinese for the first time and was so nervous that he said a few words wrong.
paragraphs.translation_en: He tried giving a report in Chinese for the first time and was so nervous that he said a few words wrong.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia mencoba memberikan laporan dalam bahasa Mandarin untuk pertama kalinya dan sangat gugup sehingga dia salah mengucapkan beberapa kata.

paragraphs.text: 時間不多了，我們得抓緊完成報告。
paragraphs.hanzi: 時間不多了，我們得抓緊完成報告。
paragraphs.pinyin: shí jiān bù duō le ， wǒ men dé zhuā jǐn wán chéng bào gào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄌㄜ˙ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄜˊ ㄓㄨㄚ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shíjiān bù duō le, wǒmen děi zhuājǐn wánchéng bàogào.
paragraphs.translation: There is not much time left; we must hurry to finish the report.
paragraphs.translation_en: There is not much time left; we must hurry to finish the report.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tidak banyak waktu tersisa; kita harus bergegas menyelesaikan laporannya.

paragraphs.text: 他為了完成報告，整整工作了一個晚上。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他為了完成報告，整整工作了一個晚上。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā wèi le wán chéng bào gào ， zhěng zhěng gōng zuò le yī gè wǎn shàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ， ㄓㄥˇ ㄓㄥˇ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄧ ㄍㄜˋ ㄨㄢˇ ㄕㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā wèi le wánchéng bàogào, zhěngzhěng gōngzuò le yí ge wǎnshang.
paragraphs.translation: To finish the report, he worked for a whole night.
paragraphs.translation_en: To finish the report, he worked for a whole night.
paragraphs.translation_id: Untuk menyelesaikan laporannya, dia bekerja sepanjang malam.

paragraphs.text: 這份報告內容太雜，讀者很難抓住要點。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這份報告內容太雜，讀者很難抓住要點。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào nèi róng tài zá ， dú zhě hěn nán zhuā zhù yào diǎn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄋㄟˋ ㄖㄨㄥˊ ㄊㄞˋ ㄗㄚˊ ， ㄉㄨˊ ㄓㄜˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄓㄨㄚ ㄓㄨˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè fèn bàogào nèiróng tài zá, dúzhě hěn nán zhuāzhù yàodiǎn.
paragraphs.translation: The content of this report is too mixed, so readers find it hard to grasp the main points.
paragraphs.translation_en: The content of this report is too mixed, so readers find it hard to grasp the main points.
paragraphs.translation_id: Isi laporan ini terlalu campur aduk, sehingga pembaca sulit memahami poin utamanya.

paragraphs.text: 他提前整理資料，從而在報告會上回答得更有把握。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他提前整理資料，從而在報告會上回答得更有把握。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā tí qián zhěng lǐ zī liào ， cóng ér zài bào gào huì shàng huí dá dé gèng yǒu bǎ wò 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄊㄧˊ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄓㄥˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ， ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄦˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄏㄨㄟˊ ㄉㄚˊ ㄉㄜˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄨㄛˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā tíqián zhěnglǐ zīliào, cóng'ér zài bàogào huì shang huídá de gèng yǒu bǎwò.
paragraphs.translation: He organised the materials in advance, thereby answering with more confidence at the report meeting.
paragraphs.translation_en: He organised the materials in advance, thereby answering with more confidence at the report meeting.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perusahaan menyesuaikan proses purna jualnya sehingga mengurangi keluhan pelanggan.
